title: Real doorway: 2.03 m lintel
description: The same opening with a standard 80-inch (2.03 m) door head above it. The obstacle height window is 0.6–2.1 m, so the lintel's bottom 7 cm counts as an obstacle at 2 m and both central sectors read as blocked.
knownIssue: Obstacle height window tops out at 2.1 m (DepthProjector.sectors maxHeight), above a standard 2.03 m door head, so doorways read as blocked.
